owner: future diagnostic collector external to Match State, Save and player
storage: immutable in-memory sidecar Map owned by opt-in external audit session; optional exclusive-create docs artifact outside live match save

separation.actual: existing Match authoritative raw execution cache/record

lifecycle.create: after independent source snapshots are sealed and original execution sample legitimately exists
lifecycle.pending: source readiness only; no sample pre-extraction
lifecycle.repeat: same primary key requires same frozen source digest and actor/route binding; return original frozen artifact, reject contradictory copies; never admit a new result by changing input digest
lifecycle.recovery: retain original pinned versions and source digest; no latest-policy reselection, new callback/vector; sidecar omission does not change official save
lifecycle.settled: append/read diagnostic only; no backfill or duplicate statistics
lifecycle.cleanup: external session close or bounded diagnostic retention; cleanup touches sidecar only

futureValidation: original callback count/order and Match RNG unchanged
no receiver model registration in family dispatch
unsupported diagnostic cannot be admitted as Settlement
thisSprint: readiness observations and source tests only; no candidate simulation or live storage implementation
sourceSnapshotDigest: immutable first-observation binding, not a retry-dependent key
